name: Lentil Bolognese with Fettuccine Pasta & Basil

instructions.primary_message: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with water; cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium carrots
3 sticks celery
1 ½ small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Trim the ends and peel the carrots; discard the trimmings and small dice the carrots. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Trim and discard the ends of the celery; small dice the celery and add to the bowl.
Heat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Peel and small dice the onion; add to the bowl with the other vegetables.
Add olive oil to the pan and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the carrots, celery, and onion to the pan and season with salt and pepper; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
⅜ black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince the garlic; transfer to a small bowl.
Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, season with salt and add the pasta; stir for the few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 9 to 10 minutes. Once done, drain the pasta.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp salt
426 g (1 quarter coin = 57 g) fettuccine pasta

instructions.primary_message: Add the garlic to the pan and stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, water, and lentils; season with salt and pepper. Cover and cook until the lentils have softened, 15 to 18 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) can diced tomatoes
3 (213 ml) can tomato sauce
1 ½ cup water
1 ½ cups French green lentils
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the sauce cooks, pick the basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and stack the leaves and thinly slice crosswise. Stir about half into the sauce (save the rest for garnishing).
Finely grate ¾ cup of Parmesan.
Divide the fettuccine noodles between bowls, top with the lentil bolognese sauce, and garnish with the Parmesan and remaining basil. Enjoy!
